content.text: BAWIPA ni a uk, talai lunghawi seh.
Tuilumnaw hai lunghawi awh naseh.
Tâmai hoi hmonae ni a ramuk teh,
lannae hoi kângingnae teh
a bawitungkhung a kamtuenae doeh.
A hmalah hmai a cei teh,
ka kalup e tarannaw teh a kak awh.
Sumpapalik ni talai a ang sak teh,
talai ni a hmu toteh a pâyaw.
Monnaw pueng teh BAWIPA hmalah,
talai van pueng teh Bawipa hmalah
khoilai patetlah koung a kamyawt.
Kalvan ni a lannae hah a pâpho teh,
tami pueng ni a bawilennae hah a hmu awh.
Meikaphawk thaw ka tawk e pueng,
ayawmyin dawk kakâoupnaw pueng teh,
kaya laihoi awm awh naseh,
cathutnaw pueng ama teh bawk awh haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Oe BAWIPA
nange lawkcengnae dawkvah,
Zion a lunghawi teh Judah canunaw hai a konawm awh.
Oe BAWIPA, nang teh talai van pueng hlak a lathueng poung lah na o.
Cathut pueng lathueng vah tawm lah na o.
Nangmouh Cathut lungpataw naw,
kathoute hah panuet awh nateh,
ama ni a tamikathoungnaw e hringnae hah a khetyawt teh,
tamikathoutnaw e kut dawk hoi a rungngang.
Tamikalannaw koe a ang teh lungthin
kalannaw koe konawmnae teh ouk a pha.
Nangmouh tami kalannaw,
BAWIPA koe konawm awh haw.
A min kathoung hah pholen awh.
